shellCommands.command: node server.js & sleep 1; curl -s -X POST -d "title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=Spice" http://localhost:3000/books -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n"; ID=$(node -e "console.log(require('./books.json')[0].id)"); curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -c 400; echo; curl -s "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID" | head -c 300; echo; curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -c done; kill %1
